about.title: Long-term relationships start with staying in touch
text: Stone Ridge was built on quality work and honest business, and we have worked for the largest midstream operators since 2015.

Our mission is quality construction and the safest possible working environment for our customers, employees and subcontractors. All construction is up to local and federal code and inspected at every stage for quality and safety.
We believe communication is key to customer service, so we stay in touch with you during all aspects of a project. Our crews are trained on the newest tools and techniques.
